sources.name: National Scholarship Portal (Government of India)
verified_facts: The portal states that Academic Year 2026-27 opened from 1 June 2026.
Renewal applications are currently open for PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS) and PM-USP Special Scholarship Scheme for Jammu Kashmir and Ladakh.
The listed student application closing date for those renewal applications is 31 October 2026; institute verification closes 15 November 2026; L2 verification closes 30 November 2026.
sources.limitations: This portal announcement does not provide the full eligibility rules, benefits, required documents, or scheme-specific detail pages for these two records.
